checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Headline reads exactly 'Start where you are' in top portion
must.why: Text is on two lines near the top, spelled correctly.

must.item: No headline letters overlap face; full face visible
must.why: Text sits above her head with a clear gap.

must.item: Smiling female fitness coach in bright studio
must.why: Smiling woman in a sports bra in a bright white studio with exercise balls.

must.item: Headline readable, inside canvas, no other text
must.why: Bold black text is legible, fully inside the canvas, and there is no other text.

faults.what: Low resolution (512x640). The legs are cropped at the hips, and the headline is somewhat plain and small-ish.

summary: A 4:5 image of a smiling coach in a bright studio with a correctly spelled, bold "Start where you are" headline above her head and no other text. The only faults are minor: low resolution and a plain headline.
